pla-0.2-standard.description: Example only: a named snapshot of native slicer profiles. Replace every value with confirmed facts.
assumptions: Confirm the installed nozzle and build plate before printing.

notes: Host-only configuration (KTD17): save as ~/.config/3d-print/local.json. Never commit it or copy its paths into a library.
Preset paths resolve relative to this file. The preset ids match slicer.preset_ids in the library's workshop.json.
Shareable facts (printer, nozzle, build plate, materials, slicer and preset ids) live in the library's workshop.json, written with the tool's `workshop set`; see workshop.example.json.
A standalone project without a library may use one combined profile: these keys plus the printer and material facts, as the legacy ~/.config/3d-print/workshop.json does.
Keep OAuth and printer credentials in their native credential stores, never here.
